The measure of an arc is equal to the measure of the [[☃ definition 1]] that intercepts it.

The arc measure of minor arc $\stackrel{\large{\frown}}{BC}$ is the measure of $\angle BPC$. We need to find the measure of  $\angle BPC$.

options.definition: A central angle is an angle whose vertex is on the center of the circle.

hints.content: The measures of $\angle BPC$ and $\angle APD$ are congruent because they are vertical angles.

question.content:
In the figure below, $\overline{AC}$ and $\overline{BD}$ are diameters of circle $P$.

**What is the arc measure of minor arc $\stackrel{\large{\frown}}{BC}$ in degrees?**



[[☃ image 1]]

[[☃ numeric-input 1]]$^\circ$

options.alt: A circle that is centered around point P. Points A, B, C, and D all lie on this circle in a clockwise direction. Line segment A C and line segment B D are diameters of the circle. Line segments A P, B P, C P, and D P are radii of the circle. The angle A P D is a one hundred fifty-five degree angle.

answers.message: When we name an arc using only 2 points, we are referring to the minor arc, that is the arc that is no more than 180 degrees.
